title: French Onion Beef Pasta
ingredients: 1/2 cup shredded Swiss or Gruyere cheese
instructions: Brown the beef; remove from pan.
Add butter and onion to the pan and cook until soft.
Add onion soup mix, beef broth, and Worcestershire sauce.
Add pasta nests. Cover and simmer 8-12 minutes, gently separating the nests as they soften.
Stir the beef back in along with the cream and cheese.
notes: One-pot meal. Creator: Chaley Jo Meeker.
